# uzc_vpc_static_route (Resource)

Manages a static route of a UzCloud VPC: traffic to `cidr` is sent to `next_hop`. When `next_hop` is in a tier managed in the same configuration, add `depends_on` on that tier so the route is deleted before it. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the route. The resource ID is "{vpc}/{route_id}".

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_vpc_static_route" "office" {
  vpc      = uzc_vpc.example.slug
  cidr     = "192.168.50.0/24"
  next_hop = "10.10.1.10"

  # next_hop is in this tier: delete the route before the tier
  depends_on = [uzc_network.app]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) Destination CIDR block, e.g. "192.168.50.0/24".
- `next_hop` (String) IP address traffic to `cidr` is forwarded to.
- `vpc` (String) Slug of the uzc_vpc the route belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "{vpc}/{route_id}". Used for import.
- `route_id` (String) Server-assigned route id.
- `state` (String) State reported by UzCloud, e.g. "Active".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_vpc_static_route.office <vpc-slug>/<route-id>
```
